mentions.name: Charity governance SaaS
mentions.description: This SaaS helps small UK charities maintain and publish policies, track key structure changes, and run governance cycles. It provides an audit log of all actions across policies, risk registers, board member terms, and key information submissions, plus a calendar and reminder system that prompts the Chair when a board member's term is ending and auto-populates upcoming meeting agendas.
mentions.problem: Existing governance tools are expensive and aimed at businesses with large boards, so they are unsuitable for smaller charities that just need to maintain policies, track structure changes, and manage governance cycles.
mentions.audience: Small UK charities that need help staying organised and running governance processes; the author built it for the small charity where they serve as a trustee.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I'm working on a small bit of SaaS which helps those organisations to stay organised, and walk them through particular processes. The two big benefits are:

1. An audit log of all actions taken across policies, risk registers, board member terms, key information submissions, etc. So you can always see who did what when.
2. A calendar + reminder system which does things like prompt the Chair when someone's term is coming to an end, and auto-populates upcoming meeting agendas.
mentions.author: bluehatbrit
